title: Day and night
examples: Teacher, what is up in the sky during the day?
When do we see the moon?
What happens when it gets dark?

explain.say: Look up high in the sky during the day. You see a bright, yellow ball. This bright ball is the sun. The sun gives us light and warmth every day.
When the sun goes down, it gets dark. The moon and stars come out at night. The moon shines softly in the dark sky. The sun and moon are different.
Our daily routine changes with the sun. We play and eat when the sun is up. We sleep when the moon is shining.
The Earth spins around and around. This spinning makes it day and then night. Sometimes the sun goes behind us. That is why it gets dark.

faq.q: Why does the sun go away at night?
faq.a: The Earth keeps spinning all the time. As it spins, part of the Earth turns away from the sun. This makes it dark for a while.
asks: Why is it dark when the sun leaves?

faq.q: Is the moon bright like the sun?
faq.a: No, the moon is not as bright as the sun. The moon actually shines by bouncing the sun's light back to us. It does not make its own light.
asks: Does the moon have its own light?

faq.q: What is our routine during the day?
faq.a: During the day, we wake up, play games, and eat our lunch. We use the sun's light to see everything around us.
asks: What do we do when the sun is up?
What is a normal day like?

faq.q: Do we sleep when the moon is out?
faq.a: Yes, most people sleep when it is dark at night. This helps our bodies rest and grow strong for the next day.
asks: Is it time for bed when it is dark?
Why do we sleep at night?

faq.q: Are the sun and the moon friends?
faq.a: They are both in the sky, but they are different. The sun is a big star, and the moon orbits around the Earth.
asks: Do the sun and moon talk to each other?
What is the difference between them?

facts: The sun is a star that gives us light and heat.
The moon shines because it reflects the sun's light.
At night, the sky is dark and we see the stars.
Our planet spins, which causes day and night.

quiz.say: What gives us light and warmth during the day?
quiz.why: The sun is the big, bright star that shines during the day.

wrong.0: The moon shines at night, not during the day.
wrong.1: Stars are small lights that mostly appear at night.
wrong.2: The Earth spins, but it does not give us light.

quiz.say: When do most people rest their bodies?
quiz.why: People need to sleep when it is dark at night to rest their bodies.

wrong.1: We are usually awake and playing during the day.
wrong.2: The sun is what happens during the day.
wrong.3: The moon is seen at night, not when we sleep.

quiz.why: The spinning of the Earth makes it turn from day to night.

wrong.0: It does not only cause night; it causes both.
wrong.2: Rain and sun are weather things, not the spinning action.
wrong.3: The Earth spinning causes both day and night.
